note: Curated field map, not an exhaustive crawl of every GitHub toy named Jarvis. Stars drift; the architecture notes do not.

systems.name: OpenClaw
systems.take: Workspace files (SOUL.md, HEARTBEAT.md, USER.md), skills folders, heartbeat that stays quiet when idle, multi-channel reach as a later layer.
systems.refuse: Curl-pipe installers, unauthenticated internet exposure, kitchen-sink plugin sprawl, defaulting every thought to Opus.

systems.name: Hermes Agent
systems.take: agentskills.io SKILL.md, skills born from experience, MEMORY.md/USER.md, provider-agnostic brain, scheduled automations.
systems.refuse: Becoming a framework you assemble instead of an assistant you live with. No HUD, no machine-control soul.

systems.name: Open Interpreter
systems.take: Human-in-the-loop for shell. Excellent for one-shot local work.
systems.refuse: It is a power tool, not a persistent JARVIS. No heartbeat, no channels, no soul files.

systems.name: OpenJarvis (Stanford)
systems.take: Local-first by default, cost/energy as first-class metrics, scheduled + continuous agents.
systems.refuse: Research platform weight. We are a production butler on one Linux machine, not PyTorch-for-agents.

systems.name: vierisid/jarvis
systems.take: Always-on daemon, authority gating, sidecar eyes on other machines.
systems.refuse: Nine-agent hierarchy and n8n-style workflow builders until the single operator loop is flawless.

systems.name: eadmin2/jarvis_ai
systems.take: Proof the world wants an Iron Man HUD on a real agent, not a chatbot.
systems.refuse: Being a skin on someone else's runtime. We own the brain and the glass.

systems.name: LocalAI
systems.refuse: A model server is not an assistant.

systems.name: Classic Python JARVIS clones
systems.take: Wake word, TTS, the cultural brief: it should feel like JARVIS.

systems.name: Dragon Claw OS
systems.class: Forge lineage — agent in a box
systems.take: Local-first mini PC, voice, smart home, one-command install.
systems.refuse: Do not dissolve JARVIS into a distro. JARVIS is the mind; the OS is the house.
